handbook:
Working hours. Core hours are 10:00 to 16:00 in the employee's local time zone. Outside core hours, employees choose when they work, provided their team knows how to reach them. Meetings should be scheduled within core hours whenever a participant would otherwise have to join outside their normal day.

Remote work. Employees may work remotely up to four days a week. Fully remote arrangements require written approval from a director and are reviewed every twelve months. Employees working remotely must use the company VPN on any network the company does not manage.

Paid time off. Full-time employees accrue 25 days of paid time off per year, prorated for part-time schedules. Up to five unused days carry over into the next calendar year; any remaining balance expires on January 31. Requests of more than five consecutive days need two weeks' notice.

Sick leave. Sick leave is separate from paid time off and is not capped. Absences longer than three consecutive working days require a note from a medical professional. Employees should tell their manager as early as possible on the first day of absence.

Parental leave. Primary caregivers receive 20 weeks of fully paid parental leave and secondary caregivers receive 8 weeks. Leave may be taken in up to three blocks within the first year after a birth or adoption. Benefits continue unchanged during leave.

Expenses. Business expenses must be submitted within 60 days with an itemized receipt. Meals while travelling are reimbursed up to 75 dollars per day. Alcohol is never reimbursed, and first-class travel requires written approval from a vice president.

Equipment. Every employee receives a laptop and may spend up to 1,000 dollars on home-office equipment once every three years. Equipment bought with company money remains company property and must be returned when employment ends.

Security. Passwords must be at least 14 characters and managed with the company password manager. Multi-factor authentication is required for every company system. Lost or stolen devices must be reported to the security team within 24 hours.

Data handling. Customer data may only be stored in approved systems and must never be copied to personal devices or personal cloud accounts. Production data must not be used for testing unless it has been anonymized by the data platform team.

Learning budget. Each employee has an annual learning budget of 1,500 dollars for courses, books, and conferences. Unused budget does not carry over. Conference travel counts against the learning budget, not the general travel budget.

Performance reviews. Performance reviews happen twice a year, in March and September. Each review includes a self-assessment, peer feedback from at least two colleagues, and a conversation with the manager. Compensation changes are decided only in the March cycle.

Leaving the company. Employees give four weeks' notice, or two weeks during the first six months. Unused paid time off is paid out in the final paycheck. Access to company systems ends at 18:00 on the last working day.
